summary: Apply subtitle MP4 edit programs on the movie clock, normalized to automatic video playback origin

before.specific_failure: Raw subtitle PTS ignores edit delay/trim/blank/reorder/repeat/open media and the selected video origin; output expansion has no cue budget. Original coincident-PTS precedence control passes.

qualification_scope: Final source passed84 integration suites and both unit filters/builds. Two additional fractional-origin witnesses and stronger video-timing controls pass all6 focused tests on unchanged production; all35 previously qualified files are byte-identical. Focus checks are not counted twice.
uncounted: Initial output-budget test corrected from3 premature input-budget refusal to6 valid input samples/8 output cues.
Incomplete mvex/no-moof open witnesses replaced with genuine text fragments, without parser weakening.
Introduced coincident-PTS ordering regression corrected before acceptance; prototype qualification logs segregated.
Variable-duration video oracle parameterization and shared unchanged video selection predicate.
migration: cues() now returns playback presentation time including edits and automatic video origin. Manual mappings should be removed; raw timestamps remain in Mp4Reader samples. Limits.samples bounds one returned cue list.
limits: Automatic video origin only; explicitly different video selections need their own origin handling.
Finite rate-one edit cases, not general styling or physical-device qualification.
A finite edit-list scan per source sample; no performance or process-wide RSS claim.
